title: The provisioner opens on boot as the sole token reader and emits provisionerReady
asA: developer whose project provisions a Hetzner Cloud VM as its cloudHost
iWant: one provisioner facade module to be the sole reader of HETZNER_ACCOUNT_API_KEY and to emit provisionerReady on boot with a metadata-only payload
soThat: the token has one auditable seam and the observability sink surfaces boot ordering without ever carrying the secret

acceptanceCriteria.description: On process boot the provisioner facade opens against the token, and (a) only the provisioner module reads HETZNER_ACCOUNT_API_KEY (grep across the fixture source refuses any other reader), (b) provisionerReady fires on the injected event sink with a payload of exactly {tool, apiHost}.

Credential missing. Given HETZNER_ACCOUNT_API_KEY unset in the applied secrets facade, when the provisioner facade opens on process boot, then the facade refuses with a named error kind (missingProvisionerToken), no provisionerReady event fires on the sink, and the error record carries no token substring.
acceptanceCriteria.given: HETZNER_ACCOUNT_API_KEY unset in the applied secrets facade
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provisioner opens on process boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade refuses with the named error kind missingProvisionerToken; no provisionerReady fires; the error record carries no token substring

acceptanceCriteria.description: Dependency not ready. Given the elicited provisioning-tool is hcloud and hcloud is absent from PATH on the process shell, when the provisioner opens on process boot, then the facade refuses with a named error kind (missingProvisionerTool) and no provisionerReady fires.
acceptanceCriteria.given: provisioning-tool = hcloud and hcloud absent from PATH
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provisioner opens on process boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade refuses with the named error kind missingProvisionerTool; no provisionerReady fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: Repeat boot idempotency. Given a completed first boot of the provisioner facade, when the process boots a second time against the same token and elicited configuration, then the facade opens again and provisionerReady fires once per boot with the same payload shape ({tool, apiHost}); no accumulator or side-channel state drifts across boots.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a completed first boot with provisionerReady already fired
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots a second time against the same token and elicited configuration
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade opens again; provisionerReady fires once per boot with the same {tool, apiHost} payload shape; no state drifts across boots

acceptanceCriteria.description: Provisioning tool raw-api. Given the elicited provisioning-tool answers raw-api, when the provisioner opens on process boot, then the facade constructs a fetch-based HTTP client against https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1 with Bearer HETZNER_ACCOUNT_API_KEY on every request (no hcloud binary invocation; grep across the fixture source refuses any child_process.execFile / spawn of hcloud); the provisionerReady payload carries tool='raw-api' and apiHost='api.hetzner.cloud'; a subsequent createServer verb issues one POST https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1/servers with the JSON body per the Hetzner Cloud API server-create schema.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the provisioner opens on process boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the facade uses fetch against api.hetzner.cloud/v1 with Bearer auth; no hcloud spawn; provisionerReady carries tool='raw-api' and apiHost='api.hetzner.cloud'; createServer POSTs /v1/servers with the documented JSON body
